cards.card_text: First up is the burnt offering, and it stays on the hearth of the altar all night, until morning.
cards.verse_text: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Command Aaron and his sons that this is the law of the burnt offering: The burnt offering is to remain on the hearth of the altar all night, until morning, and the fire must be kept burning on the altar.

cards.card_text: Then the LORD gives a picture: Ariel "will be like an altar hearth before Me."
cards.verse_text: And I will constrain Ariel, and there will be mourning and lamentation; she will be like an altar hearth before Me.
cards.snippet: …there will be mourning and lamentation; she will be like an altar hearth before Me.

cards.card_text: When the potter's jar shatters, not one piece will be left big enough to scoop coals from a hearth.
cards.verse_text: Not a shard will be found in the dust large enough to scoop the coals from a hearth or to skim the water from a cistern.”
cards.snippet: …found in the dust large enough to scoop the coals from a hearth or to skim the water from a cistern.”

cards.card_text: Then the voice gives the altar's measurements in long cubits: a gutter at the base, ledges stepping up, a square hearth twelve cubits each way with four horns, and steps facing east.
cards.verse_text: The altar hearth shall be four cubits high, and four horns shall project upward from the hearth.
